drivers: Latin-square distribution of shape/count across rows is easily spotted and narrows options to two (E/F)
Rotation rule (+45° per cell within a row) is consistent and simple, but must be inferred from only two cells in the final row
Distractor E differs only in rotation (180° vs 90°), and triangle rotations can be visually confusable
Generous 90-second limit and no fill/texture variation reduce load
